notes.title: Game Update.
notes.content:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We’ve prepared an update for Paranormal Torment:

1. Fixed a crash bug related to loading/unloading locations

2. Fixed bugs with colored corridors

3. Improved functionality of the code lock

4. Improved character lightbulb behavior

5. Enhanced some jumpscare mechanics

6. Added shader compilation notification

7. Improved lighting performance

8. Enhanced sound quality

9. Fixed text errors

10. Other minor bug fixes
